glossary.definition: (A) "Street or interurban railway company" includes any person, association, firm, or corporation owning any lands or property used for street or interurban railway purposes and any lessee thereof.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 5551.01 to 5551.10 , inclusive, of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 5551.01 - Acquisition of railway right of way definitions.

glossary.definition: (B) "Road" includes any state or county road, or the street of any municipal corporation, or any part of such road or street, which forms a continuous road improvement.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 5551.01 to 5551.10 , inclusive, of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 5551.01 - Acquisition of railway right of way definitions.
